recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. If the build regenerates the SVG from another source, ensure the generated diagram preserves the DocumentReference.bodyStructure label/link; no further FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-39129.
issue_request: FHIR-39129 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 SD issue asking DocumentReference to carry Media attributes encounter, bodysite, and modality, with bodySite/modality elements and search parameters plus encounter search support.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #2501, merged as accd7ce497462e69c5b61c8ec6ded4af7c93b4f8, and implementation commit e41db687b398699cf93fb3dff28b80d554c9c311 added DocumentReference.bodySite, DocumentReference.modality, coded body-site/modality search parameters, and the DICOM example content. Encounter search support was already present through the common clinical-encounter search parameter for DocumentReference.
additional_context: Later Applied issue FHIR-53203 renamed OO bodySite elements/search parameters to bodyStructure/body-structure for R6, and source/fhir.ini records the bodySite-to-bodyStructure and context.encounter-to-context mappings. Related Published issue FHIR-38966 added the reference-side body-site search parameter and is already represented on the combined branch. OO minutes for 2022-12-13 record FHIR-39129 as persuasive, and no conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/documentreference/documentreference-example-dicom.xml to use bodyStructure and updated source/documentreference/documentreference.svg to link/label DocumentReference.bodyStructure. The authoritative StructureDefinition and search parameter source were left unchanged because they already contain modality, bodyStructure, context/encounter, and the corresponding current search parameters.
